features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit (F9111, F9104-B, F9114, F9114-B); power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Extremely discreet pinhole sensor for machines and ATMs
Up to 1080p at 60 fps or 720p at 180 fps with AXIS F9111 (1080p 30 fps / 720p 60 fps with other F91 units)
IP66/IP67 aluminum front casing, NEMA 4X; EN 45545-2 / NFPA 130 (railway)
AXIS F8202 Straight Mounting Bracket included; SMA connector
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f7225-re-pinhole-sensor-en-US-386738.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. consumption_w is the sensor unit's own max draw per datasheet.
